Stage 1 decomposition coordinates. The figure uses molecular layers layer 1, layer 2. (A) layer
1 molecular-layer coordinates. (B) layer 2 molecular-layer coordinates. Facets identify
molecular layers; points show component 1 sample coordinates rank-ordered within each layer;
the dotted horizontal line marks zero. Point colours and point shapes encode categorical
planted group. The subtitle reports the stored synthetic ground-truth angle for component 1.
The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is cross-sectional; the
estimand is the descriptive sample coordinate on component 1. No component-selection threshold
is applied. This display does not select a component or establish biological interpretation.
